# Independent revision wire fixtures

These original public synthetic fixtures use MIT OR Apache-2.0. The common
contract owns the complete closed tagged decimal-string objects and one-MiB
control byte envelope. The pinned primitive package retains all 48 original
parsed revision expectations; this package adds exact raw bytes and literal
canonical outputs before their consumer is written.

Field order and JSON whitespace may vary. Valid ASCII Unicode escapes preserve
decoded keys, tags and decimal strings. Duplicate decoded fields, extra fields,
wrong types, invalid encodings, malformed JSON, trailing data, wrong typed tags
and noncanonical or out-of-range payloads fail. Numeric payloads never pass
through binary64. Valid body recipes at the byte limit isolate its inclusive
boundary; padding is literal ASCII space, not an oracle or production helper.

WireRevision retains the distinct checked scalar variant. Its display emits the
complete kind/value object; scalar display and FromStr remain decimal payloads.
A static unit error retains no rejected bytes. Supplied typed traits and literal
formatter expectations do not grant compare-and-swap or revision authority.
This is a bounded specialized closed-object parser, not general source JSON,
locator unsigned-token admission, JCS, HTTP streaming or product qualification.
All remaining whole-primitive and actual consumer gates remain required.
